purpose: The limited remote test before any long run: does OmniVoice's official adaptation recipe (k2-fsa/OmniVoice 08be0b4c, SOTA_ROADMAP.md section 8) install, tokenise and train on a Kaggle T4 pair at its full size, and at what memory and speed. Nothing it trains is kept; its losses are not a quality result.

budget_declared_before_the_push.expected_hours: about 1 to 1.5: install 6 min, downloads 5 min, data slice 3 min, tokenising 5 min, flex attempt up to 30 min, SDPA 10 min, the memory fallback and equivalence check up to 30 min only if needed
budget_declared_before_the_push.hard_limits: each command has its own timeout (data 30 min each, tokenising 60 min each, flex 30 min, SDPA 40 min); Kaggle's own session limit is 12 h
budget_declared_before_the_push.quota_context: about 30 GPU-hours a week; this week's measured use so far is the MOSS v1.5 runs of 2026-09-18 (probe v2 24 min, v3 about 18 min, v4 about 17 min) and the Fish and Higgs kernels of 2026-09-17

pinned.runtime: OmniVoice's uv.lock: torch 2.8.0+cu128, torchaudio 2.8.0+cu128, transformers 5.3.0, accelerate 1.13.0, webdataset 1.0.2, safetensors 0.7.0, tokenizers 0.22.2, huggingface-hub 1.7.2 - checked, the run stops on any difference
pinned.tokenizer: eustlb/higgs-audio-v2-tokenizer 528e871c2a26c4f0f7773b9754e2e1acae20899d, sha256 fe7c5e87... checked against the copy bundled with the base
pinned.configs: train_config_finetune.json, train_config_finetune_sdpa.json and data_config_finetune.json fetched at the commit and checked against their git blob ids
pinned.data: one parquet shard each of pymmdrza/Common-Voice-Speech-26.0-Persian-Clean @ 142e9bb4 and shekar-ai/neyshekar @ 30696ada; train and valid clips only, from eval/manifests/adaptation_splits_v1.jsonl.gz

gates: sdpa-memory (only if sdpa runs out of memory)

what_decides_next.sdpa passes: the full recipe fits a T4 pair as published; its measured seconds per step give the full run's cost
what_decides_next.sdpa runs out of memory, sdpa-memory and: the full recipe runs with gradient checkpointing and DDP bucket views, both recorded as memory-only changes
what_decides_next.nothing fits, or the budget exceeds the: no long run; the report gives the evidence and the full-recipe command for bf16-capable hardware, nothing reduced
what_decides_next.flex: expected to fail on Turing per the official docs; recorded either way
